pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

lenses.note: Bug fix matching the PR words. The fix has one obvious design, so no spec was needed.
There is no spec file in this change.

Three new tests cover no-match, escaping and the empty-table case. The no-match test would fail on the old code. test/apply-migrations.js has a beforeEach that resets the DB, so the DELETE in the third test cannot leak into other tests. I did not run the tests, which need the Workers runtime. CI runs them.
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. No docs mention the message.
The extra COUNT query runs only when a search finds nothing. The empty message is built from fixed text plus an escaped query, so injecting it unescaped into the template is safe.
The query is escaped with escapeHtml in the message, and a test covers it. SQL stays parameterised.
The diff touches no UI or style files, only message text in a server-rendered template.
No UI flow or browser changes beyond one message string.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff. The PR text says 'the page template takes the message', and that is true.
